name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Carousel (embla). Every slide is a panel: its content gets a 2px ink frame on paper (ink-case-inner). Previous / Next are the kit outline icon button with a brush arrow: the tone shadow appears on hover, pressed is a negative with impact lines, focus is the ink / paper / ink ring, disabled is dashed with a tone frame. Under 640px they grow to 44px and sit inside the carousel width, in a row under the slides (stock places them 48px outside). Adds CarouselDots, a mangacn addition built on useCarousel: square dots, the current one an ink flat that sweeps in, 24px hit areas (44px under 640px). Manga reading order: under data-reading="rtl" (or opts.direction "rtl", or dir="rtl") embla runs right to left, slides flow right to left, the arrows and arrow keys follow; text stays left to right. Vertical orientation puts the buttons above and below and uses the up / down keys.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/carousel". It wraps your own components/ui/carousel (embla, the same in Radix and Base UI) and draws Previous / Next with the kit Button. CarouselDots is mangacn's own addition (not in shadcn): place it inside Carousel, after the buttons. The carousel follows the page's manga reading order (data-reading="rtl") and writing direction (dir="rtl") by itself; opts.direction overrides it. From 640px the buttons sit 48px outside the slides, as in shadcn: leave room around the carousel (sm:px-12). Vertical: give CarouselContent a height and leave room above and below for the buttons (py-14). Put one element in each CarouselItem: it becomes the panel.

meta.tagline: Panels in a strip, turned with brush arrows.
meta.usage:
import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselDots, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious } from "@/components/ui/manga/carousel"
